settings.name: Content
settings.description: What content is shown and how it is classified.

settings.name: Allow Mature Content
settings.description: Allow watching of mature content.

settings.name: Shorts Duration Threshold
settings.description: Videos with duration less than or equal to this value (in seconds) will be classified as shorts and displayed in the dedicated tab.

settings.name: Home Feed
settings.description: What appears in the home feed.

settings.name: Show Live Streams in Home Feed
settings.description: Show active live streams at the top of the home feed.

settings.name: Live Streams in Home
settings.description: Maximum number of live streams shown at the top of the home feed.

settings.name: Show Shorts in Home Feed
settings.description: Include short-form videos in the home feed. When disabled, only full-length videos are shown.

settings.name: Video Sources
settings.description: Which stream variants are probed and offered for playback. Fewer sources = faster video details loading.

settings.name: Preferred Source
settings.description: Which source the player picks first. Adaptive uses HLS for quality switching on variable networks; Fixed uses MP4 v6 for consistent single-quality playback.

settings.name: MP4 v6 (fast, reliable)
settings.description: Include the player.odycdn.com v6 MP4 source.

settings.name: MP4 v3 (fallback)
settings.description: Include the api/v3 MP4 source as a fallback. Reliable but slightly slower than v6.

settings.name: HLS v6 (adaptive streaming)
settings.description: Include the v6 HLS master playlist for adaptive bitrate playback. Availability varies by video.

settings.name: HLS v4 (legacy)
settings.description: Include the legacy api/v4 HLS playlist. Same coverage as HLS v6 but slower. Disabled by default.

settings.name: MP4 v4 (legacy)
settings.description: Include the legacy api/v4 MP4 source. Redirects to HLS when available (emitted as an HLS source automatically). Redundant and slow; disabled by default.

settings.name: Privacy
settings.description: What information is sent back to Odysee.

settings.name: Provide Odysee Activity
settings.description: Tell Odysee what you played.

settings.name: Performance
settings.description: Performance-related behaviour.

settings.name: Extra requests to load view count
settings.description: Send additional requests (batched) to load view counts for each video. Will slow down loading.

settings.name: Diagnostics
settings.description: Logging and troubleshooting.

settings.name: Session Warnings
settings.description: Show toast notifications when the Odysee session is expired or degraded.

settings.name: Verbose Notifications
settings.description: Show toast notifications for plugin trace messages and failed requests.
